result.brief: Proposed corporate office for Ikeja Holdings Ltd in Ikeja, Lagos, measured from architectural model Ikeja_Office.ifc only with no supporting documents. The building comprises Entry Level plus two upper floors with Parapet and flat Roof, approximately three storeys. Frame is mixed precast concrete beams, in-situ circular concrete columns, minor structural steelwork and precast hollow-core floors with concrete topping, with concrete block external walls, extensive aluminium curtain-wall glazing and granite panels, and flat concrete deck roof with tapered insulation and EPDM. Internal partitions are metal stud with plasterboard, ceilings are acoustic tiles and plasterboard, floors carpet and timber, with 100 doors and only pendant and sconce lights modelled; foundations, reinforcement, wall and floor build-ups, joinery details and full MEP services are not shown.

questions.question: No foundations, footings, pile caps, ground beams or column bases are measured - only ground slab is shown. Confirm foundation design and whether L004-L005 include thickenings?
All concrete stated as mix to be confirmed and no reinforcement measured. Confirm concrete grades and provide reinforcement schedules for slab, columns, stairs, topping and walls?
Held generic slabs (400mm, 75mm, Pad 1, stair landings) and Generic 200mm walls were excluded as guessing - are these structural elements that must be added to substructure, floors and walls?

Precast hollow-core planks plus separate concrete topping and slab edge measured, but thickness, plank depth, topping thickness and bearing details unknown. Confirm proprietary system and composite build-up to avoid double-counting?

Curtain-wall measured as loose mullions by length plus glazing by area - confirm system supplier, mullion/transom sizes, bracket and gasket system, glass thickness/type and whether granite panels are part of same system?
Flat roof measured as single composite item with build-up, mix and thicknesses to be confirmed. Confirm screed, falls, insulation thickness, EPDM thickness, flashings, outlets and roof access?

Only 37 light fittings with wiring/conduit to be confirmed are measured; no power, distribution boards, HVAC, plumbing, fire fighting or data shown. Confirm architectural-only scope and obtain full MEP design?

Structural steel joists, curved and wide-flange beams/columns given by weight only with spans, bearings, connections and corrosion/fire protection to be confirmed. Confirm connection design and painting/fire rating?
All 100 doors and 24 windows lack leaf/frame material, fire rating for non-rated sets, glazing type and hardware schedule. Confirm timber/steel/aluminium, finishes and ironmongery specification?
Block walls and insulation measured but block thickness, mortar mix, wall ties, coping to parapet and external render/cladding finish unknown. Confirm wall build-up and external finish?

Stair flights, landings, stringers, pipe railings and handrails measured with paint/fixings to be confirmed, plus 10 held stair runs/landings. Confirm stair finishes, balustrade heights and whether held runs duplicate measured flights?
Carpet throughout upper floors and timber finish in one area with no screed, skirting or expansion details. Confirm floor build-up, screed thickness and skirting?
